description: This Java class acts as a command handler for processing withdrawal commands on fixed deposit accounts within the Fineract system. It implements the interface NewCommandSourceHandler and delegates the withdrawal operation to the DepositAccountWritePlatformService.

classes.name: WithdrawalFixedDepositAccountCommandHandler
classes.description: A service class that handles withdrawal commands for fixed deposit accounts, adhering to the NewCommandSourceHandler interface.

methods.name: processCommand
methods.description: Processes withdrawal commands by delegating to the deposit account write platform service to perform the withdrawal operation for fixed deposit accounts.
